title: 诺奖得主杜德纳：花园领奖，仅11人见证，诺贝尔奖的仪式感去哪了？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: This is where you accepted the Nobel.
segments.zh: 这就是你领取诺贝尔奖的地方。

segments.en: Yes. Like right here. Right here.
segments.zh: 是的，就在这儿，就在这儿。

segments.en: Tell me about that moment. Well, it was in the heart of the pandemic.
segments.zh: 跟我讲讲那一刻吧。那是在疫情最严重的时候。

segments.en: And normally it's done in Stockholm, Sweden.
segments.zh: 通常颁奖是在瑞典斯德哥尔摩。

segments.en: And so the Nobel committee said, Well, we're going to send the Nobel to you.
segments.zh: 诺贝尔委员会说，我们会把诺贝尔奖寄给你。

segments.en: And we're going to give it to you in your garden.
segments.zh: 并在你的花园里颁发给你。

segments.en: When you wake up the next day, does the world just open up?
segments.zh: 第二天醒来，世界是否豁然开朗？

segments.en: Or do you feel a weight of responsibility?
I'm honest. I mean, it was so overwhelming.
segments.zh: 说实话，那感觉太震撼了。

segments.en: I didn't go into science with any thoughts of winning prizes, believe me.
segments.zh: 我投身科学从未想过获奖，真的。

segments.en: You know, I just hoped I could get a job someday.
segments.zh: 我曾希望有朝一日能找到工作。

segments.en: My husband said to me, Well, now your main job is being an ambassador for science.
segments.zh: 我丈夫说，现在你的主要工作是做科学大使。

segments.en: I thought, how do I do that?
Being the face of a scientific revolution is a lot of pressure, even for Jennifer Doudna, a legend in biology, who helped her in CRISPR into a breakthrough method for altering DNA,
segments.zh: 作为科学革命的代言人压力巨大，即便对生物学传奇人物珍妮弗·杜德纳也是如此。她将CRISPR发展为改变DNA的突破性方法，

segments.en: tackling everything from genetic disease to climate change, and spawning dozens of companies in the process.
segments.zh: 应对从遗传病到气候变化的一切问题，并催生了数十家公司。

segments.en: But some critics claim the tech hasn't lived up to its hype just yet, not to mention the ethical concerns.
segments.zh: 但一些批评者认为该技术尚未达到预期，更不用说伦理问题了。

segments.en: At the same time, movie depictions of biotechnology have been exactly been great PR for gene editing.
segments.zh: 与此同时，电影对生物技术的描绘对基因编辑来说并非好的公关。

segments.en: More human than human is our motto. It didn't matter how much I lied.
segments.zh: 我们的座右铭是比人类更人性化。不管我撒了多少谎。

segments.en: My real resume was in my cells.
segments.zh: 我真正的简历在我的细胞里。
